researcher: Agent: current local source and isolated authoring CLI probes
official_api: Project-owned backend.authoring.list_node_types, describe_node_type and build_workflow(write=False). The CLI is a thin adapter. No outside API is needed.
sign_in: None for metadata/check-only operations. They do not resolve secret values or call a model.
cost: No paid calls, network or generation. Local CPU/memory only; performance not benchmarked.
reliability: 55 authorable / 56 registered types observed at 3f36552. Check-only probes returned valid, invalid and warning-only reports without creating any data-root entries. New wrappers, caps, cancellation, richer diagnostics and source-contract normalization still require a future build.
terms_of_service: Internal project APIs only; no new service terms/account dependency. Existing nodes described in the catalogue keep their own execution/setup conditions.
reason: The reusable discovery and check-only backend already exists; new workflow nodes and precise adapter contracts do not.
conditions: Owner approves the proposed contracts, caps and samples

Build verifies no save/name lookup/execute/network path is invoked; an ephemeral validation graph is allowed
Catalogue overflow is an explicit error; choose filters/budgets before using its output as complete context
alternatives: Use a frozen reviewed catalogue in a configured Context Pack for an initial manual loop
